Hi Mina,

Thanks for the intro call earlier — Rajiv and I want to get the tenant set up next week so our engineers can start smoke-testing the integration. To help us move fast, can you confirm the following and share a short seed plan we can provide to our IT team?

1) Project & namespace naming convention you recommend for multi-env (dev/staging/prod).
2) Steps to seed initial API keys and rotate them safely (we need a non-prod-first approach).
3) Suggested admin role matrix (who needs Owner vs Admin vs Developer).
4) Any SSO or SCIM prerequisites for our Okta setup.

We attached a csv with the tentative admin list. If you can share a short playbook and an invite cadence, we’ll lock in a 2-hour window next Tue.

Thanks,
Sara

From: mina_haddad@redwood.com
To: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@averylabs.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation kickoff - initial details

Sara — great to connect earlier. Attaching a concise playbook (onboarding-maestro-playbook.pdf) and a proposed invite cadence. High-level answers below and a quick mutual action plan so we can hit a working tenant by Fri.

Quick answers:
- Naming: {company}-{env}-{project}, e.g. avery-prod-redwood-integration. Keep project short (<=20 chars).
- API key seeding: create two initial admin keys in a staging project; seed service account with scoped keys for ingestion and a separate key for realtime calls. Rotate one key at a time and test fallback.
- Role matrix: Owner (org admins only), Admin (CS + Platform leads), Developer (eng, scoped to projects), ReadOnly (auditors).
- SSO/SCIM: we support Okta SAML + SCIM; need metadata XML and a SCIM service account with write permissions for groups.

Mutual action plan (dates are target):
- Thu 09/23: Confirm admin list (Avery to confirm CSV) — Owner: Sara
- Fri 09/24: Seed staging project + two admin keys — Owner: Mina (Redwood)
- Mon 09/27: Engineering smoke test (Avery) — Owner: Rajiv
- Tue 09/28: SSO kickoff (if needed) — Owner: Monica & Avery IT
- Wed 09/29: Prod admin seed + initial RBAC mapping — Owner: Mina

Notes: I included the two attachments you sent in our thread and a short checklist inside the PDF. If Thu works, I’ll request the 2-hour slot for Fri morning.

Thanks,
Mina H.
Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: onboarding-maestro-playbook.pdf (12 pages)
Attachment: Avery_Org_Admins.csv (contacts)

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tenant activation kickoff - initial details

Adding a few implementation-level details to make the seed repeatable:

1) Project template commands (CLI):
- redwood projects create avery-staging --env staging --owner avery-infra
- redwood projects create avery-prod --env prod --owner avery-admins

2) API key best practice snippet (do not embed in repo):
- create scoped key: redwood keys create --project avery-staging --scope ingestion,low-cost --label "staging-rest-key"
- create rotation policy: redwood keys rotate --key-id <id> --grace-period 48h

3) RBAC mapping suggestion (CSV column names in attached file):
- owner: sara.ellis@averylabs.com
- admin: rajiv@averylabs.com, avery-platform@averylabs.com
- developer: eng-team@averylabs.com

I’ll prepare a short script we can run during the seed to create projects and seed keys idempotently. Also flagging: if they want KMS-backed keys, we’ll need their KMS ARN before we seed prod keys.

jonas
Infra & Deployments
Redwood Inference
